scenes.facts: Dark water fills the tall chamber called the Upside-down Sinners. Beneath its distorted surface, old human dead hang head-down from ropes and heavy chains. Mineral-stained arches and rusted fittings rise into the darkness; a dry stone threshold gives space to stand above the waterline.
scenes.socialContext: The suspended remains provide unsettling evidence without a resolved explanation. The room’s inherited name establishes neither the dead’s guilt nor a killer’s identity; no fresh death, active drowning, supernatural host or obligation to enter the water follows.

scenes.art: The flooded Upside-down Sinners chamber in Warcraft’s Forgotten Crypt. View from a broad DRY low stone threshold across dark blue-green water into tall mineral-stained gray arches and rusted chain fittings. Beneath the water surface, a few distant PALE NONLIVING HUMAN CORPSE SILHOUETTES hang head DOWN from old ropes secured to heavy chains, partially hidden by distortion and reflection. Restrained iconic gothic horror, no graphic wounds, nudity, blood or fresh violence. Cold reflected light from a small visitor lamp reveals only nearest still submerged forms; far vault remains black. Clear dry lower-middle standing ledge. No living figures, drowning action, ghosts or named villain.

scenes.label: Mosshide Fen: The common above the marsh
scenes.facts: A gnoll-built common in Mosshide Fen rests on a modest raised timber-and-stone causeway. Mossy hide awnings, rough flint tools and scavenged containers frame a clear speaking patch above the ordinary wet ground. Reeds, broad marsh trees and dark shallow channels enclose the approach.
scenes.socialContext: This practical adaptation to the fen supports a local exchange about resources, travel or habitation. It supplies no dam failure, active flood, ecological crime, cannibalism or hostile chief; its raised floor is ordinary wetland craft rather than evidence of a named disaster.

scenes.label: Scarlet Monastery: The Chamber of Atonement
scenes.facts: The Graveyard wing’s outer Chamber of Atonement places an empty restraining table and wall manacles beneath pale vaulted monastery stone. Orderly iron implements and a statements desk occupy one side. Red-white devotional cloth hangs above the apparatus; the far arch admits burial-ground daylight from the Forlorn Cloister.
scenes.socialContext: Scarlet interrogation gives the room its coercive history. Actual custody, beliefs and personalities determine the encounter; the empty equipment supplies no torturer, victim, confession, punishment or consent, and religious membership never makes a prisoner willing.
